_comment: Лирика референс-альбома VELVET STATIC (ветка brain-v2-reference, audits/brain-v2/REFERENCE-ALBUM.md). Общий вход для A и B — копирование текстов не влияет на сравнение caption.

lyrics.title: Sign-On
lyrics.lyrics:
[spoken, over static]
Good night. You found the frequency.
Nobody listens at this hour. That's why it works.

[verse, whisper]
Low tide breathes beneath the harbour wall.
The neon leans against the fog.
Somebody's light is on across the water.
Somebody always stays.

[chorus, melodic rasp]
(backing: stay, stay, stay)
This is velvet static on your skin.
The night is big enough for both of us.
(backing: both of us)

[outro, whisper fading]
Stay tuned. The tide is coming in.

lyrics.title: Fog-Ledger
lyrics.lyrics:
[verse, spoken ledger]
Item one: the ferry that never docks.
Item two: the dog that counts the trains.
Item three: your name, unspoken, on the list
of everything the fog keeps safe.

[pre-chorus, whisper rising]
(backing: low, low)
The ledger of the night is open.

[chorus]
Everything lost tonight belongs to me.
I keep it on the shelf of static and sea.
(backing: sea, sea)

[bridge, spoken]
Item four: the promise you almost made.
Filed under: later. Under: rain.

[outro, whisper]
The fog is patient. So am I.

lyrics.title: Salt in the Wires
lyrics.lyrics:
[verse, whisper to rasp]
Salt got into the wires again.
Every song comes back changed.
The chorus hums through rusted veins.
The signal tastes like rain.

[chorus, melodic rasp]
(backing: salt, salt in the wires)
We burn a little slower every night.
We burn a little brighter every song.
(backing: every song)

[spoken, over breakdown]
The equipment's older than the promise.
It still remembers how to sing.

[chorus, repeat]

lyrics.title: Caller 03:14
lyrics.lyrics:
[spoken]
Caller on line three. Go ahead, you're on the air.

[verse, call-and-response whisper]
(backing: tell me)
Why does the dark feel warmer than the day?
(backing: tell me)
Why do the ships all answer when I pray?

[chorus, melodic rasp]
Caller, I don't have the answers, I have static.
But static holds you closer than the light.
(backing: closer than the light)

[bridge, both voices implied]
Stay on the line. The night is long.
Stay on the line. You're not alone.

[outro, whisper]
Line three went quiet. The song went on.

lyrics.title: The Velvet Public
lyrics.lyrics:
[pre-chorus, whisper building]
(backing: dance, dance)
There is a ballroom made of fog.
Everyone who cannot sleep is welcome.

[chorus, melodic rasp, layered whisper harmonies]
The velvet public dances out of time.
Nobody cares what hour it is outside.
(backing: outside, outside)
Sleepless hearts keep rhythm just fine.

[spoken, breakdown]
If you're awake, you're on the guest list.

[chorus, repeat with ad-libs]
(ad-lib: all night long)

lyrics.title: Deep Water Frequency
lyrics.lyrics:
[verse, whisper]
The deep water frequency is calling me home.
Below the shipping lanes, below the fog.
A chord struck slow on drowned guitars.
A bass line like a second heartbeat.

[chorus, melodic rasp, layered harmonies]
(backing: deep, deep, deep)
Tune to the water. Tune to the low.
The loudest song is the one below.
(backing: the one below)

[spoken, near-silence before drums re-enter]
...and for one moment, the whole sea held its breath.

[chorus, final, waves of volume]

lyrics.title: Interference Prayer
lyrics.lyrics:
[verse, whisper]
Two stations breathing on one frequency.
Your prayer bleeds into my song.
The interference sounds like forgiveness.

[chorus, soft rasp]
(backing: amen, amen)
Every word dissolves into the hum.
That's where words belong.

[outro, spoken]
This part of the night is quiet.
Quiet is a prayer too.

lyrics.title: Room Above the Radio
lyrics.lyrics:
[verse, spoken room]
The room above the radio shakes a little
every time the bass drum lands.
I sleep beside my own broadcast.

[chorus, melodic rasp]
(backing: beside, beside)
The floor is thin, the night is kind.
My voice comes up to meet me from below.
(backing: from below)

[bridge, whisper]
If you hear me snoring on the air —
that's the encore.

lyrics.title: Ghosts of the Harbour Choir
lyrics.lyrics:
[verse, whisper]
The harbour choir rehearses when the port sleeps.
Drowned sailors hum the harmonies
of every song I ever played too late.

[chorus, rasp over ghost layers]
(backing ghost choir: ohh, low)
Sing with them, they never tow the line.
They learned the words from drowning in the rhyme.
(backing: in the rhyme)

[outro, whisper fading into choir]
Goodnight, choir. Rehearse without me.
I'll join you when the tape runs out.

lyrics.title: Sign-Off Delayed
lyrics.lyrics:
[spoken]
This is the part where I say goodnight.

[verse, whisper]
But the tide is loud and the city's soft.
Somebody's window is still lit.
The sign-off can wait one more song.

[chorus, melodic rasp]
(backing: one more song)
Delayed, delayed, the sign-off is delayed.
The night asked nicely and I stayed.
(backing: and I stayed)

lyrics.title: The Tape That Outlives Us
lyrics.lyrics:
[verse, whisper]
When they find these reels a hundred years from now,
the oxide will remember what we said.
A whisper is the longest-lasting thing
a human voice can do.

[chorus, soft rasp]
(backing: last, last)
The tape outlives the throat. The hum outlives the hand.
Velvet static, sealed against the dark.
(backing: against the dark)

[spoken, near-silence]
Play it slow. That's how it was meant.

lyrics.title: Sign-Off, Finally
lyrics.lyrics:
[verse, whisper]
The tide came in. The fog went home.
The ledger closed itself.

[chorus, melodic rasp, softest]
(backing: goodnight, goodnight)
This was velvet static. This was ours.
The frequency will hold you till the light.
(backing: till the light)

[spoken, over fading static]
Good night. You kept the frequency.
The tide is in. The tape is done.
(sign-off click)
